chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Abū Yaḥyā al-Wāsiṭī, from some of our companions, from Abū al-Ḥasan al-Māḍī عليه السلام, who said:
He was asked about the collected water in the bathhouse from the washings of the people that comes onto a garment. He said: “There is no harm in it.”

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; it is unobjectionable
key_terms.يُصِيبُ الثَّوْبَ: it reaches or splashes onto the garment

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on bathhouse wash-water splashing onto clothing?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning water gathered in a bathhouse from people’s washings when it touches one’s clothing. The Imam عليه السلام states that there is no problem with it, indicating permissibility and the absence of objection in this case.
